# clio failure record

record one attempt, its failure, and the lesson

## Usage

```
clio failure record TASK_ID --attempt-n N --what-failed W --lesson L [--evidence-ref E] [--context TEXT] [--dry-run] [--bank BANK] [--output json|text]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TASK_ID` | yes | The task record the command reads or writes: `task upsert` writes it and the others read or file against it. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--attempt-n N` | uint |  | Numbers the attempt; `cli_write_persona::failure_record_call` parses it with `parse_u64` into `attempt_n`. |
| `--what-failed W` | text |  | Describes what failed; `cli_write_persona::failure_record_call` sends it as `what_failed`. |
| `--lesson L` | text |  | Records the lesson; `cli_write_persona::failure_record_call` sends it as `lesson`. |
| `--evidence-ref E` | text |  | Names supporting evidence; `cli_write_persona::failure_record_call` sends it as `evidence_ref`. |
| `--context TEXT` | text |  | Adds freeform context; `cli_write_persona::failure_record_call` sends it as `context`. |
| `--dry-run` |  |  | Previews the write without storing it; `cli_write_persona` sends `dry_run` as true to the write tool. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio failure record t-1 --attempt-n 1 --what-failed "timeout" --lesson "backoff"
```

```
clio failure record t-1 --attempt-n 1 --what-failed "timeout" --lesson "backoff" -o json
```

preview
```
clio failure record t-1 --attempt-n 2 --what-failed "timeout" --lesson "backoff" --dry-run
```
